mapper.select: select rp.param_id as paramId, rp.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, rp.product_id as productId, rp.safety_stock as safetyStock, rp.max_stock as maxStock, rp.cycle_days as cycleDays, rp.lead_days as leadDays, rp.season_coef as seasonCoef, rp.enable_flag as enableFlag, rp.update_time as updateTime, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.unit as unit from t_replenish_param rp inner join t_product p on p.product_id = rp.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' where rp.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and rp.product_id = #{productId}

select rp.param_id as paramId, rp.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, rp.product_id as productId, rp.safety_stock as safetyStock, rp.max_stock as maxStock, rp.cycle_days as cycleDays, rp.lead_days as leadDays, rp.season_coef as seasonCoef, rp.enable_flag as enableFlag from t_replenish_param rp inner join t_product p on p.product_id = rp.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' where rp.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and rp.enable_flag = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into t_replenish_param (enterprise_id, product_id, safety_stock, max_stock, cycle_days, lead_days, season_coef, enable_flag, update_by, update_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{productId}, #{safetyStock}, #{maxStock}, #{cycleDays}, #{leadDays}, #{seasonCoef}, #{enableFlag}, #{updateBy}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update safety_stock = values(safety_stock), max_stock = values(max_stock), cycle_days = values(cycle_days), lead_days = values(lead_days), season_coef = values(season_coef), enable_flag = values(enable_flag), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate()
